post.headline: Decide how an email fits the review
post.subtext: Email Validation gives recipients and staff a plain result they can read before an outside email shapes the next inbox decision.
post.image_alt_text: A Hush Line daily social asset showing the desktop Email Validation screen. The graphic shows a raw email headers field, a Validate Headers button, a Download Report button, and a validation summary saying the email appears to originate from the stated sender.

social.bluesky:
Some messages arrive in Hush Line. Others reach a recipient by ordinary email.

Email Validation shows whether Hush Line says an email appears to originate from the stated sender, so staff can decide how it fits the next inbox review.

Review messages with Hush Line: https://hushline.app.
social.linkedin:
Some messages arrive in Hush Line. Others reach a recipient by ordinary email and still need a careful read.

Email Validation gives recipients and staff a place to paste the email's original metadata and see whether Hush Line says it appears to originate from the stated sender. That helps a newsroom, law office, educator, or security desk decide how the email fits the next inbox review.

Use Hush Line to review sensitive messages with the context your team needs: https://hushline.app.
